payload.abstract: Effective processing and analysis of physiological data requires specialized software. We have developed a large collection of such software over the past thirty years, and much of it is contained within the WFDB (Waveform Database) Software Package. The WFDB Software Package comprises over 70 applications for signal processing and automated analysis. A comprehensive collection of documentation, including tutorials and reference manuals, is also included in the package. The package is written in highly portable C and can be used on all popular platforms, including GNU/Linux, MacOS, MS-Windows, and all versions of Unix. The package has also been ported to other popular languages, including Matlab and Python.
payload.short_description: The original Waveform Database Software (WFDB) Package, in C.
payload.title: WFDB Software Package
